English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

campagne

  1. plural of campagna

Dutch

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kɑmˈpɑ.njə/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: cam‧pag‧ne
  • Rhymes: -ɑnjə
  • Homophone: Campagne

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from French campagne.

Noun

[edit]

campagne f (plural campagnes, no diminutive)

  1. (politics, society) campaign
    Synonym: offensief
Derived terms
[edit]
  • boostercampagne
  • campagneleider
  • gezondheidscampagne
  • lastercampagne
  • vaccinatiecampagne
  • verkiezingscampagne
  • voorlichtingscampagne
Related terms
[edit]
  • plan de campagne

Etymology 2

[edit]

From Middle Dutch campagne, campanie. This etymology is incomplete. You can help Wiktionary by elaborating on the origins of this term.

Noun

[edit]

campagne m or f (plural campagnes, no diminutive)

  1. (military) campaign, offensive
    Synonyms: offensief, veldtocht

French

[edit]
French Wikipedia has an article on:
campagne
Wikipedia fr

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kɑ̃.paɲ/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɲ

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from Old Occitan campanha or Old Northern French campaigne, corresponding to Old French champa(i)gne. Doublet of Champagne and champagne.

Noun

[edit]

campagne f (plural campagnes)

  1. country (the country, rural area, as opposed to the town or city), countryside
    Near-synonym: paysage
Derived terms
[edit]
  • battre la campagne
  • maison de campagne
  • pain de campagne
  • rase campagne

Etymology 2

[edit]

Probably borrowed from Italian campagna, itself from Late Latin campania, from Latin campus.

Noun

[edit]

campagne f (plural campagnes)

  1. campaign
Derived terms
[edit]
  • campagne électorale
  • faire campagne
Descendants
[edit]
  • → Czech: kampaň
  • → English: campaign
    • → Hebrew: קמפיין (kampéin)
  • → German: Kampagne, Campagne (alternatively in Switzerland, else obsolete)
    • → Hungarian: kampány

Further reading

[edit]
  • “campagne”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kamˈpaɲ.ɲe/
  • Rhymes: -aɲɲe
  • Hyphenation: cam‧pà‧gne

Noun

[edit]

campagne f

  1. plural of campagna

Old French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Late Latin campānia.

Noun

[edit]

campagne oblique singular, f (oblique plural campagnes, nominative singular campagne, nominative plural campagnes)

  1. the countryside
